text: The core of aerospace science and technology lies in achieving technological breakthroughs for "flight" and "exploration of space", covering activities both within the atmosphere and beyond it. The specific research scope includes: Aviation field: The design, aerodynamic layout, power system, structural strength, flight control, navigation and guidance of aircraft (planes, helicopters, drones, etc.) that fly within the Earth's atmosphere.Spaceflight field: The orbit design, propulsion technology, thermal protection, attitude control, life support, and deep space exploration of spacecraft (launch vehicles, satellites, manned spacecraft, space stations, deep space probes, etc.) that fly outside the atmosphere. This discipline emphasizes the integrated development of the "theory - design - manufacture - test - application" entire process. It relies on basic sciences such as mathematics, physics and mechanics, and also involves engineering technologies such as materials, mechanics, electronics and control. It is a typical "highly specialized" interdisciplinary field.
